name: ThetaFirm Core R-Theta 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; ThetaFirm, RepRapFirmware in 4-axis mode (to4axis.g). Machine coordinates: bed angle C, radius X, Z,
; tilt B (B0 = nozzle straight down). Copied verbatim into the polar G-code.
G90 ; absolute coordinates
M83 ; relative extrusion
M140 S0 ; no heated bed
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; set extruder temp
G28 ; home all
G1 Z50 F600 ; clear the bed before turning the nozzle
G1 B0 F3000 ; nozzle straight down
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for extruder temp
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
; Machine coordinates, copied verbatim.
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0
M104 S0 ; extruder heater off
M107 ; fan off
G91
G1 Z10 F600 ; lift
G90
G1 B0 F3000 ; nozzle straight down
M84 ; motors off
printer_notes: Joshua Bird's Core R-Theta 4-axis printer with the ThetaFirm RepRapFirmware configuration (https://github.com/PDAMUK/ThetaFirm), in 4-axis mode: bed angle C (continuous), radius X (-37.5 to 115.5 mm), Z, and nozzle tilt B (0 = straight down, negative leaning outward), with inverse time feed (G93). The firmware positions the tilt pivot, 43 mm above the nozzle tip, so radius and Z are compensated for the tilt. Measure the nozzle length and toolhead radius of your build for the clearance check.
